senses.gloss: f.(b. h. חֻפָּה; חפף I)covering, canopy, esp. bridal chamber; also (= כניסה לח׳) the entrance of the bride into the bridal chamber; wedding.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 5a:16">Kidd. 5ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ח׳ קונה</he> the introduction into the bridal chamber constitutes possession (legitimate marriage).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 3a:5">Ib. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>למעוטי ח׳</he> to exclude, as a form of marriage, the delivery by her father to take her into the bridal chamber.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>לא ראה בחוּפָּתִי</he> was not present at my wedding.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108a:20">Snh. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>עשה ח׳ לבנו</he> arranged a bridal room for his son.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:21">Ab. V, 21</cite> <he>בן י״ח לח׳</he> at eighteen years one is fit for marriage.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 2:5:3">Y. Succ. II, 53ᵃ</cite> top; Bab.
<cite ref="Sukkah 25b:10">Succ. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>בני ח׳</he> wedding party; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חוּפּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:2">Lam. R. to III, 19</cite> <he>כך וכך ח׳ וכ׳</he> so many state rooms will I arrange &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:15:3">Y. Sot. IX, end, 24ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:9">Tosef. Sot. XV, 9</cite> <he>אלו הן ח׳ חתנים</he> these are the bridal canopies (which were interdicted after the destruction of the Temple); (Bab. ib. 49ᵇ <he>חוּפַּת</he> sing.).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25">Lev. R. s. 25</cite>, beg.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: seat of the Divine Majesty, sanctuary.—Pl. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:12:4">Y. Meg. I, 72ᵈ</cite> top <he>כל ח׳ שהיו וכ׳</he> all sanctuaries (Shiloh, Gilgal &c.) which existed &c.
